es: Resolver una llegada a una ciudad: plantear un problema de alojamiento, pedir aclaración ante jerga y resumir la semana con bloques naturales.

teaching.en: Hello, the heating isn't working, and my room is freezing.
teaching.es: Hola, la calefacción no funciona y mi habitación está helada.
teaching.explanationEs: Plantea el problema con un dato concreto: qué no funciona y qué consecuencia tiene.
teaching.audioText: Hello, the heating isn't working, and my room is freezing.

teaching.en: Could you send someone to fix it today, or at least tomorrow?
teaching.es: ¿Podría enviar a alguien a arreglarlo hoy, o al menos mañana?
teaching.explanationEs: Could you…? pide con cortesía; send someone to + verbo indica para qué.
segments: Could you send someone to fix
it today, or at least tomorrow?
teaching.audioText: Could you send someone to fix it today, or at least tomorrow?

teaching.en: Sorry, what do you mean by «dodgy»? I didn't catch that.
teaching.es: Perdona, ¿qué quieres decir con «dodgy»? No lo he entendido.
teaching.explanationEs: Ante jerga, repite la expresión y pregunta What do you mean by…? en vez de asentir sin entender.
segments: Sorry, what do you mean by
teaching.audioText: Sorry, what do you mean by «dodgy»? I didn't catch that.

teaching.en: So, to make sure I understand, you will send a plumber on Friday?
teaching.es: Entonces, para asegurarme de que lo entiendo, ¿enviará a un fontanero el viernes?
teaching.explanationEs: Confirmar con tus palabras evita malentendidos; to make sure + sujeto + verbo.
segments: So, to make sure I understand, you
will send a plumber on Friday?
teaching.audioText: So, to make sure I understand, you will send a plumber on Friday?

teaching.en: Basically, I paid a deposit last week, so the room should be ready.
teaching.es: Básicamente, pagué una fianza la semana pasada, así que la habitación debería estar lista.
teaching.explanationEs: Basically resume lo esencial; deposit es una cantidad que se paga por adelantado.
segments: Basically, I paid a deposit last week,
so the room should be ready.
teaching.audioText: Basically, I paid a deposit last week, so the room should be ready.

teaching.en: It's not like I'm complaining, but the ceiling has a leak.
teaching.es: No es que me queje, pero el techo tiene una gotera.
teaching.explanationEs: It's not like… suaviza la queja antes de dar el dato; leak es una gotera o fuga.

prompt.es: La calefacción no funciona. ¿Qué frase plantea el problema con cortesía?

choices.text: You never fix anything, so fix the heating now.
Hello, the heating isn't working, and my room is freezing. Could you fix it today?

feedback.es: Un buen planteamiento da el dato, la consecuencia y una petición con Could you.

hint.es: Busca el mensaje con dato concreto y petición educada.

feedback.es: What do you mean by… sirve para pedir el sentido de una expresión que no entiendes.

hint.es: Es el verbo para preguntar el sentido de una palabra.

prompt.es: Ordena: «No es que me queje, pero el techo tiene una gotera.»

answer.text: It's not like I'm complaining, but the ceiling has a leak

feedback.es: It's not like… suaviza la queja antes de dar el dato del problema.

hint.es: Empieza con el bloque que quita importancia a la queja.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué debe hacer Sara.

choices.text: Be at home on Friday before ten.

feedback.es: El fontanero vendrá el viernes por la mañana y Sara solo tiene que estar en casa antes de las diez.

origin.audio: Hi Sara, it's the agency. The plumber can't come today, but he will fix the heating on Friday morning. Basically, you just need to be home before ten.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para asegurarme de que lo entiendo, ¿enviará un fontanero el viernes?»

feedback.es: To make sure + sujeto + verbo sirve para confirmar con tus palabras lo que has entendido.

origin.text: So, to make ___ I understand, you will send a plumber on Friday?

prompt.es: Alguien usa una expresión coloquial que no conoces. ¿Qué respondes?

choices.text: Sorry, what do you mean by that? Could you rephrase it?

feedback.es: Repetir la expresión y pedir otra forma de decirlo evita asentir sin entender.

prompt.es: Escribe al casero: problema, petición, aclaración de «dodgy», confirmación y resumen.

answer.text: Hello Carlos, it's Sara from room four. The thing is, the heating isn't working, and my room is freezing at night. Could you send someone to fix it today or tomorrow? You said the heating was a bit dodgy, and sorry, I didn't catch that. What do you mean by dodgy? Could you rephrase it? So, to make sure I understand, it is unreliable and it breaks down a lot, and you will send a plumber on Friday morning. Basically, I paid a deposit last week, so I hope we can sort it out soon. To be honest, my first week has been pretty hard, but I managed to find a good café, and I avoid complaining too much. Anyway, thank you for your help, and have a lovely weekend. Kind regards, Sara.
accepted: Hello Carlos, it's Sara from room four. The thing is, the heating isn't working, and my room is freezing at night. Could you send someone to fix it today or tomorrow? You said the heating was a bit dodgy, and sorry, I didn't catch that. What do you mean by dodgy? Could you rephrase it? So, to make sure I understand, it is unreliable and it breaks down a lot, and you will send a plumber on Friday morning. Basically, I paid a deposit last week, so I hope we can sort it out soon. To be honest, my first week has been pretty hard, but I managed to find a good café, and I avoid complaining too much. Anyway, thank you for your help, and have a lovely weekend. Kind regards, Sara.

Hi Carlos, it's Sara. Basically, the heating in my room stopped working three days ago, and it's freezing at night. Could you send a plumber to fix it as soon as possible? You told me it was dodgy, sorry, what do you mean by that? I didn't catch the word. So, to make sure I understand, the heating is unreliable and someone will come on Friday, right? To be honest, it's not like I'm angry, but I paid a deposit last week, so I would like a warm room. I managed to get used to the city, and I avoid complaining too much, but I need some help with this. Thanks a lot for your time, and have a lovely weekend. Best wishes, Sara.

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje plantea el problema con datos, pide el arreglo con cortesía, pide aclaración de la jerga, confirma lo entendido y resume la semana con bloques.

origin.text: Acabas de llegar a una ciudad. La calefacción de tu habitación no funciona y el casero dijo que «is a bit dodgy», pero no lo entendiste. Escribe un mensaje (entre 120 y 200 palabras): plantea el problema, pide que lo arreglen, pregunta qué significa «dodgy» con What do you mean by…?, confirma lo que has entendido y resume tu primera semana con un bloque (to be honest, the thing is…) y un verbo con to o -ing (manage to, avoid + -ing).

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué promete el casero.

choices.text: That Sara will pay the plumber.
That the heating is completely new.
That the agency will cover the repair cost.

feedback.es: El casero dice que la agencia pagará todo, por eso Sara no tiene que preocuparse por el coste.

origin.audio: Sara, it's Carlos. The plumber says the heating is dodgy, so he will change a part on Friday. No worries about the cost: the agency will pay for everything.

feedback.es: La pregunta necesita el auxiliar does seguido del sujeto y el verbo mean.

prompt.es: Completa: «Logré evitar quejarme toda la semana.»

feedback.es: Avoid va seguido de gerundio y manage va seguido de to + verbo.

origin.text: I managed to ___ complaining all week.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por lo visto, el casero enviará a un fontanero el viernes.»

answer.text: Apparently, the landlord will send a plumber on Friday

feedback.es: Apparently abre la frase para contar lo que has oído, seguido del futuro con will.

prompt.es: Un amigo te dice «I'm beat». ¿Qué respuesta es natural?

choices.text: Bummer! Go and get some rest.

feedback.es: Beat es cansado, así que lo natural es compadecerse y sugerir descansar; las otras leen beat como golpear o ganar.

prompt.es: Resume tu semana con un bloque natural: «Para ser sincero, lo hice todo yo solo.»

answer.text: To be honest, I managed to do everything on my own.
accepted: To be honest, I managed to do everything on my own.
To be honest, I managed to sort everything out by myself.

feedback.es: Un resumen natural usa to be honest y manage to + verbo para expresar el logro.

origin.text: Quieres decir que, para ser sincero, lograste hacerlo todo tú solo.
